Container.Name: music-ui
Container.Overview: Web music player for a Navidrome server: cascading filters (music folder, genre, artist, album), a fast track table, playlists with drag and drop, and a player. The app talks to Navidrome from the server side only, so Navidrome does not need to be exposed to the network.
Container.Requires: A Navidrome server (0.58 or later) reachable from this container, with one Navidrome library per music folder and a user that can access all of them. If Navidrome runs on this Unraid server, put both containers on the same custom Docker network and use http://navidrome:4533 (or use the server's IP and Navidrome's port).

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Library catalog and app settings (SQLite). Must be writable by nobody:users (99:100), the default owner of appdata.

Config.Name: Navidrome URL
Config.Description: Navidrome address as seen from this container, e.g. http://navidrome:4533 (same Docker network) or http://192.168.1.10:4533.

Config.Name: Navidrome user
Config.Description: Navidrome account used by the app (a non-admin user with access to every library).

Config.Name: Navidrome password
Config.Description: Password of that account. Only used on the server; never sent to the browser.

Config.Name: Sync interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often to check Navidrome for library changes (0 = only at startup and on manual rescan).
